title: LLM Output Parsers
summary: This module provides various output parsers to transform raw LLM responses into structured formats like lists, XML, YAML, Pydantic objects, or Pandas DataFrames. It also includes parsers for specific data types like datetime and mechanisms for fixing parsing errors.

nodes.label: Parse Comma-Separated List
nodes.title: CommaSeparatedListOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a list of strings separated by commas, handling CSV-like formats.

nodes.label: Parse Numbered List
nodes.title: NumberedListOutputParser
nodes.description: Extracts items from a numbered list format (e.g., '1. item') in LLM output.

nodes.label: Parse Markdown List
nodes.title: MarkdownListOutputParser
nodes.description: Extracts items from a Markdown-formatted list (e.g., '- item') in LLM output.

nodes.label: Base Streaming Parser
nodes.title: BaseTransformOutputParser
nodes.description: Abstract base class for output parsers capable of processing streaming input chunks.

nodes.label: Cumulative Streaming Parser
nodes.title: BaseCumulativeTransformOutputParser
nodes.description: Extends BaseStreamingParser to accumulate and parse streaming input, optionally yielding diffs between parsed states.

nodes.label: Parse XML Output
nodes.title: XMLOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output formatted as XML into a dictionary, supporting streaming and secure parsing.

nodes.label: Parse Datetime String
nodes.title: DatetimeOutputParser
nodes.description: Converts LLM-generated string output into a Python datetime object based on a specified format.

nodes.label: Parse Enum Value
nodes.title: EnumOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output to match one of the predefined string values in a Python Enum.

nodes.label: Fix Parsing Errors
nodes.title: OutputFixingParser
nodes.description: Wraps another parser and attempts to fix parsing errors by sending the problematic output to an LLM for correction.

nodes.label: Parse Pandas DataFrame Query
nodes.title: PandasDataFrameOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output to extract data or perform operations on a given Pandas DataFrame.

nodes.label: Retry Parsing with LLM
nodes.title: RetryOutputParser
nodes.description: Wraps another parser and retries parsing with LLM assistance if an error occurs, using the original prompt context.

nodes.label: Parse Structured Output
nodes.title: StructuredOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output into a structured dictionary based on a list of defined response schemas.

nodes.label: Parse YAML to Pydantic
nodes.title: YamlOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output formatted as YAML into a Pydantic object, validating against the model schema.

nodes.label: Parse Tool Calls
nodes.title: ToolsOutputParser
nodes.description: Parses LLM output containing tool calls into a structured format, optionally using Pydantic schemas for validation.

nodes.label: Base Output Parser Interface
nodes.title: BaseOutputParser
nodes.description: The foundational abstract base class for all output parsers, defining the core `parse` method.

nodes.label: Base Generation Parser Interface
nodes.title: BaseGenerationOutputParser
nodes.description: Abstract base class for parsers that operate on `Generation` objects, typically from chat models.

nodes.label: Language Model
nodes.title: BaseLanguageModel
nodes.description: A language model providing raw text or message outputs, used for re-prompting in fixing/retrying parsers.

nodes.label: Prompt Template
nodes.title: BasePromptTemplate
nodes.description: Defines the structure and content for prompts given to LLMs, guiding their output or correction.

nodes.label: Pydantic Schema
nodes.title: Pydantic Data Model
nodes.description: A Pydantic data model defining the expected structure and types for parsed output.

nodes.label: Pandas DataFrame
nodes.title: Pandas DataFrame Object
nodes.description: A tabular data structure from the Pandas library, used as context or target for parsing operations.

nodes.label: Raw LLM Output
nodes.title: Unprocessed LLM Response
nodes.description: The initial, unprocessed text or message output generated by a Language Model.

nodes.label: Structured Parsed Output
nodes.title: Final Structured Data
nodes.description: The final, structured data produced by an output parser after processing the raw LLM output.

groups.label: List Parsers
groups.title: Parsers for List Formats
groups.description: Parsers designed to extract structured lists from LLM text output.

groups.label: Transform Parsers
groups.title: Streaming and Transformative Parsers
groups.description: Parsers that handle streaming input and transform it, including cumulative parsing and XML.

groups.label: Structured Data Parsers
groups.title: Parsers for Complex Structured Data
groups.description: Parsers for converting LLM output into complex structured data formats like JSON, YAML, or tool calls.

groups.label: Utility Parsers
groups.title: Specialized and Error-Handling Parsers
groups.description: Parsers for specific data types (datetime, enum) and mechanisms to fix or retry parsing errors.
